# F4 — Multi-branch menu overrides, stock transfers, purchase suggestions

Status: implemented (backend + admin UI + tests). All v1 conventions apply (CONVENTIONS.md): JSON camelCase, enums snake_case,
money `numeric(18,2)`, quantities `numeric(18,3)`, ProblemDetails `code`. Permissions are the existing catalog entries.

## Schema changes (one migration `Branches_F4` to be generated by the orchestrator)

| Table / column | Notes |
|---|---|
| `ingredients.default_supplier_id` (uuid, null, FK suppliers restrict) | groups purchase suggestions |
| `branch_menu_items` (id, organization_id, branch_id, menu_item_id, price_override?, is_available?, kitchen_station_id?, audit cols) | unique (branch_id, menu_item_id); FKs branch / menu item / kitchen station restrict |
| `branch_menu_item_variant_prices` (id, branch_menu_item_id, variant_id, price) | unique (branch_menu_item_id, variant_id); cascade from parent |
| `stock_transfers` (id, organization_id, number, from_branch_id, to_branch_id, status, comment, sent_at/by, received_at/by, cancelled_at/by, xmin, audit cols) | unique (organization_id, number); indexes (from_branch_id, status), (to_branch_id, status) |
| `stock_transfer_lines` (id, stock_transfer_id, ingredient_id, quantity(18,3), unit_id, base_quantity(18,3), unit_cost?) | cascade from transfer |
| enum `StockMovementSource` += `transfer` (string column, no DDL) | movements of transfers: `transfer_out` / `transfer_in`, `sourceType=transfer`, `sourceId=transferId` |

## 1. Per-branch menu overrides

Resolution (ONE place, `BranchMenuResolver`): effective `price = priceOverride ?? item.price`, variant price = branch variant
price ?? variant price, `isAvailable = !archived && (override.isAvailable ?? item.isAvailable)`,
`kitchenStationId = override.kitchenStationId ?? item.kitchenStationId`. Used by `GET /menu/pos` and by order item creation
(`POST /orders`, `POST /orders/{id}/items`): the price snapshot and the station snapshot come from the current branch, so
send-to-kitchen routes to the branch's station (a station of another branch falls back to the branch's default station, as in v1).
Existing order items keep their snapshots.

| Method | Path | Permission | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/menu/items/{id}/branches` | `menu.read` | org-level; one `BranchMenuItemDto` per active branch |
| PUT | `/menu/items/{id}/branches/{branchId}` | `menu.manage` | org-level; replaces the override; all null + no variant prices → override removed |
| DELETE | `/menu/items/{id}/branches/{branchId}` | `menu.manage` | 204, idempotent |
| PUT | `/menu/branch-availability/{menuItemId}` | `menu.manage` **or** `kitchen.status.update` | `X-Branch-Id`; stop-list toggle for the current branch; `{ isAvailable }` |

```ts
SaveBranchMenuItem = { priceOverride: number|null, isAvailable: boolean|null, kitchenStationId: Guid|null,
                       variantPrices: { variantId, price }[] }
BranchMenuItemDto = { branchId, branchName, menuItemId, hasOverride, priceOverride, isAvailable, kitchenStationId,
  kitchenStationName, effectivePrice, effectiveIsAvailable, effectiveKitchenStationId,
  variants: { variantId, variantName, basePrice, priceOverride, effectivePrice }[] }
```
Errors: 404 `menu_item.not_found`, 409 `menu_item.archived`, 404 `branch.not_found` (inactive / other org),
404 `kitchen_station.not_found` (station not active in THAT branch), 400 `menu_item.invalid_variant`, 400 `validation.failed`.

## 2. Stock transfers (`X-Branch-Id` = the branch acting)

Flow: `draft → sent → received`, `draft|sent → cancelled`. Number sequential per organization.
Visibility: source branch sees its transfers in any status; destination sees them once `sent` (drafts are private). Others → 404.

| Method | Path | Permission | Side | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/stock/transfers?status=&direction=incoming\|outgoing&page=&pageSize=` | `inventory.read` or `inventory.transfer` | both | paged, number desc, `lines: []` |
| GET | `/stock/transfers/{id}` | same | both | with lines |
| POST | `/stock/transfers` | `inventory.transfer` | source | 201 draft; source = X-Branch-Id |
| PUT | `/stock/transfers/{id}` | `inventory.transfer` | source | replace draft (409 `stock_transfer.not_editable` otherwise) |
| POST | `/stock/transfers/{id}/send` | `inventory.transfer` | source | base qty + unit cost (ingredient CostPrice) fixed; `transfer_out` per line at source via the single StockLedger; honours the source's AllowNegativeStock → 409 `stock.insufficient`, nothing saved |
| POST | `/stock/transfers/{id}/receive` | `inventory.transfer` | destination | **Idempotency-Key**; `transfer_in` per line at destination with the send cost; replay → same response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); new key → 409 |
| POST | `/stock/transfers/{id}/cancel` | `inventory.transfer` | source | from `sent` the stock returns to the source (`transfer_in`, reason "Transfer #N cancelled") |

Branch access: the user must pass `X-Branch-Id` validation for the acting branch (`tenant.branch_forbidden` otherwise), i.e.
access to the source to create/send/cancel and to the destination to receive. Creating does not require access to the destination.

```ts
SaveStockTransfer = { toBranchId, comment?, lines: { ingredientId, quantity, unitId }[] }   // ≤200 lines, distinct ingredients
StockTransferDto = { id, number, fromBranchId, fromBranchName, toBranchId, toBranchName,
  status: 'draft'|'sent'|'received'|'cancelled', direction: 'outgoing'|'incoming', comment, totalCost, lineCount,
  createdAt, sentAt, receivedAt, cancelledAt,
  lines: { id, ingredientId, ingredientName, quantity, unitId, unitCode, baseQuantity, baseUnitCode, unitCost|null }[] }
```
Errors: 404 `stock_transfer.not_found`, 409 `stock_transfer.not_editable`, 409 `stock_transfer.invalid_status_transition`,
422 `stock_transfer.empty`, 422 `stock_transfer.same_branch`, 404 `stock_transfer.destination_not_found`,
403 `stock_transfer.source_branch_required`, 403 `stock_transfer.destination_branch_required`, 409 `stock.insufficient`,
404 `ingredient.not_found`, 422 `ingredient.archived`, 404 `unit.not_found`, 422 `unit.conversion_missing`, 409 `concurrency.conflict` (xmin).

## 3. Purchase suggestions (`X-Branch-Id`)

`GET /purchases/suggestions?coverageDays=0..90&lookbackDays=1..90` (default 0 / 14) — `purchases.read`. Per ingredient with a balance
in the branch (base unit): `avgDaily = Σ consumption movements(last lookbackDays) / lookbackDays`,
`target = minQuantity + avgDaily × coverageDays`, `onOrder` = remaining qty of draft/submitted/partially received POs of the branch,
`suggested = ceil₃(target − current − onOrder)`; only lines with `suggested > 0`. Grouped by the ingredient's default supplier
(archived/none → group `supplierId: null`, listed last). `lastPrice` = ingredient CostPrice.

```ts
PurchaseSuggestionsDto = { coverageDays, lookbackDays, groups: { supplierId|null, supplierName|null, estimatedTotal,
  lines: { ingredientId, ingredientName, baseUnitId, baseUnitCode, currentQuantity, minQuantity, onOrderQuantity,
           avgDailyConsumption, targetQuantity, suggestedQuantity, lastPrice, estimatedTotal }[] }[] }
```

`POST /purchases/suggestions/apply` — `purchases.manage`; body `{ lines: { ingredientId, supplierId, quantity, unitPrice? }[], expectedAt?, comment? }`
→ **201** `PurchaseDto[]`: one draft PO per supplier (base unit, price = given or CostPrice), all in one transaction (any error rolls back
all drafts). Errors: 404 `ingredient.not_found`, 404 `supplier.not_found`, 422 `supplier.archived`, 422 `ingredient.archived`, 400 `validation.failed`.

Ingredients: `POST/PUT /ingredients` accept `defaultSupplierId?` (404 `supplier.not_found` when missing/archived);
`IngredientDto` adds `defaultSupplierId`, `defaultSupplierName`.

## Seed (Development only)

`DemoSecondBranchSeeder` (runs once, also on existing dev DBs): branch "Ташкент — Чиланзар" with floor + 3 stations, access for
`manager@` and `stock@` (owner/admin see all branches), opening stock for 10 ingredients (several below minimum), station overrides
to the same-named local stations, +5 000 price override on the two priciest items, default suppliers for demo ingredients.

## Admin UI

- Menu → items: row action "По филиалам" (matrix: price, variant prices, availability, station per branch; reset).
- Stock / Inventory: new tab "Перемещения" (list with direction/status filters, create/edit draft, send, receive, cancel).
- Purchases: "Предложения" dialog (coverage days, editable quantities, create drafts per supplier).
- Ingredient form: "Поставщик по умолчанию".
- Not done in UI: the kitchen/waiter quick stop-list button (endpoint `PUT /menu/branch-availability/{id}` is ready).
- No new realtime events: clients refetch (transfers are not pushed to the destination).
